ciel.name: La station météo
ciel.alt: A hilltop weather station on a changeable day, painted in ink and gouache: a little bird peeps out of a nest piled with snow, a white poodle floats up in the storm wind like a kite, a cross thermometer bursts its red line out of the top, a broom sweeps by itself through the grey mist over a pond, big raindrops splash into a wooden bucket, a mountain goat bleats on the roof of the weather hut beside its big dial, a girl lets go of a whistling red balloon, a blue van with puffed cheeks blows a gust of wind, a little cloud meditates cross-legged, orange lightning crashes over the distant village, a lightning bolt strikes a chocolate éclair on the grass, a boy floats down under an umbrella opened like a parachute, a friendly witch stirs a bubbling cauldron of brew that pours fog across the yard and a grey cloud drops a huge iron weight with a boom. The white dome leads to the observatory, the launch tower to space, the starry gate to the star garden and the stone arch at the far end to the stormy end of the station; an old tree stump on the left can be looked at closer, and the white gate at the bottom left leads out to the map.

doors.label: L'observatoire
doors.hint: Go in through the door of the white observatory dome

doors.label: L'espace
doors.hint: Climb the launch tower to the space deck

doors.label: Les étoiles
doors.hint: Go through the starry gate to the night garden

doors.label: Les intempéries
doors.hint: Walk through the stone arch to the far end of the station

zooms.label: la souche
zooms.hint: Look closer at the old tree stump

souche.name: La vieille souche
souche.alt: Close-up of the old tree stump at the weather station: a little food truck struck by a tiny lightning bolt, a striped wind sock whipping in the wind on its pole, two bees braced against swirling gusts of cold north wind, a cat asleep on a warm pipe in a cloud of steam, a little iron weather vane, a little girl whose hair has puffed up into a cloud, a red jelly with frost sparkles and a crystal ball showing a sun and a sheep-shaped cloud.

espace.name: L'espace
espace.alt: The top deck of the launch tower at twilight: a seagull clings in surprise to the nose of a rocket blasting through the atmosphere, painted as a huge glowing glass sphere, a snail sets off along an endless path of stepping stones across the sky, a cat in a cowboy hat tips its hat from the window of a round space station, an astronaut waves a boarding pass at the moon, a cloud shaped like the letter L floats in the blue, a unicycle floats among the planets with a bunch of tiny galaxies sharing its seat, a ship sails toward the golden horizon, a blob of blue jelly sits on top of a big globe, and an owl flaps past a passing satellite. The round hatch in the middle of the deck leads back down to the weather station.

doors.label: La station météo
doors.hint: Go back down through the round hatch to the weather station

etoiles.name: Les étoiles
etoiles.alt: A magical night garden under the stars: a galaxy swirls in the sky, a loon sings to the full moon from a little stone tower, a little star wrapped in a bath towel sits on a cloud, a green alien unfolds a plan of the planets, a boy with a guitar sings beside an empty rowing boat on the pond, an astronaut waves at a huge shining celestial body and the sun lounges in a deckchair. The open starry gate on the right leads back to the weather station.

doors.label: La station météo
doors.hint: Go back through the starry gate to the weather station

intemperies.name: Les intempéries
intemperies.alt: The far end of the weather station, where the weather changes from one side to the other: a cow shelters her calf under a giant leaf in the pouring monsoon, a sweltering girl in a sun hat tips a watering can of cool water over her head beside a bursting thermometer, a scarecrow in a dress with a red sash stands over cracked dry earth beside a wilting sunflower, a TV weather presenter points at a map as a meteor streaks behind her, a deckchair waits in the sunshine, a weather scientist in round spectacles and a white coat checks the weather instruments with her clipboard, a hurricane swirls over a big map of Oregon on the grass, a little blue car is parked in the rain, a weather hut is frozen inside a giant wobbly block of frosty gelatin, a tornado spins three identical cows into the sky, a woman's long scarf streams out in the strong wind on the trail and a penguin toboggans on its belly across a road of black ice. The stone archway on the left leads back to the weather station.

doors.label: La station météo
doors.hint: Go back through the stone archway to the weather station

observatoire.name: L'observatoire
observatoire.alt: A hilltop beside the white observatory at night: a beetroot circles a little planet, a little cottage glows with candlelight, an astronomer in a woolly hat peers through a brass telescope at a comet, a planetary model has an orange for the sun and a pea for the Earth, a little girl astronaut in a spacesuit leaps past the cratered moon, the observatory dome opens and its great telescope swings toward the stars, a garden gnome sits on a cloud eating flatbread, a toy rocket blasts off from its launch pad and a little girl explorer in a blue parka plants a red flag on the pole while a penguin looks on. The wooden garden gate at the bottom left leads back to the weather station.

doors.label: La station météo
doors.hint: Go back through the wooden garden gate to the weather station
